C# — Photography and data acquisition

Correspond `EpicEye.Capture.cs`to trigger camera filming and reconstruction, capture frame markings and download complete EpicRaw data;dissemination of document contents C# — EpicRaw Parsing.

API Reference

TriggerCapture / TriggerCaptureAsync

Purpose: Trigger one shot and rebuild and return to the sole of the frame. frameId. Structure light is usually called once to complete the collection; passive eyes need to be visible to open the corresponding sign.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

string

Camera address.

withPointCloud

bool

Whether the camera should generate a point cloud; Default: true.

passiveBinocular

bool

Whether to capture in passive binocular mode; Default: false.

timeout

int

Request timeout in milliseconds; Default: 5000.

Returns: ApiResponse<string>, Data Yes. frameId.

GetFrameInEpicRaw / GetFrameInEpicRawAsync

Purpose: Downloads the complete EpicRaw saved by the camera for the specified frameId. The data is not decoded during download.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

string

Camera address.

frameId

string

Frame identifier.

aligned

bool

Value of aligned; Default: false.

timeout

int

Request timeout in milliseconds; Default: 5000.

Returns: byte[]?;failed returns null.

GetFrameInEpicRawWithTimeStats / GetFrameInEpicRawWithTimeStatsAsync

Purpose: Download EpicRaw, and measure the response time-consuming and effective network ingestion, allowing for a distinction between camera computing and transmission bottlenecks.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

string

Camera address.

frameId

string

Frame identifier.

aligned

bool

Value of aligned; Default: false.

timeout

int

Request timeout in milliseconds; Default: 5000.

Returns: (epicRawBytes, networkTransmitTimeMs, networkSpeedMbps);bytes are as at the time of failure null, the statistical value is 0. Ignores cameras when they do not support alignment download aligned.withPointCloud=false The size of the camera calculation and file can be reduced, but no cloud elements can be obtained from the frame after that.

Example: Trigger, download and load the document

using TFTech;

string ip = "192.168.1.10:5000";
var trigger = await EpicEye.TriggerCaptureAsync(
    ip,
    withPointCloud: true,
    passiveBinocular: false,
    timeout: 10000);

if (trigger.Status != 0 || string.IsNullOrEmpty(trigger.Data))
{
    Console.WriteLine(trigger.ErrorMessage);
    return;
}

var download = await EpicEye.GetFrameInEpicRawWithTimeStatsAsync(
    ip,
    trigger.Data,
    aligned: false,
    timeout: 15000);

if (download.epicRawBytes is null ||
    !EpicEye.TryLoadEpicRawDocumentFromBytes(download.epicRawBytes, out var document) ||
    document is null)
{
    Console.WriteLine("EpicRaw Downloading or parsing failed");
    return;
}

Console.WriteLine($"Format: {document.FileType}");
Console.WriteLine($"Transfer: {download.networkTransmitTimeMs:F1} ms, {download.networkSpeedMbps:F1} Mbps");
